route: Work permit (Employment of Non-Citizens Act), with the residence permit

permit.applies: The employer advertises the post and the worker applies for the work permit with the contract of employment and the letter of offer; the Washington embassy takes applications from the United States.
permit.first: A job advert of at least 14 days, open only to Batswana citizens during that time, and a contract of employment.

fees.what: Application for work permit (Embassy in Washington)
Renewal of work permit (Embassy in Washington)

sources.title: Embassy of the Republic of Botswana in Washington, D.C., Residence Permit Application (Permits: Residence/Work Permit)
sources.said: All expatriates who want to enter the Republic of Botswana for the purposes of employment. … Proof of a job advert … Advert should circulate for a minimum of 14 days. … Within the 14-day circulation, applications are only open to Batswana citizens. … Contract of employment. … Letter of offer/appointment letter … $165 (Application for Work Permit) … $165 (Renewal of Work Permit) … Processing time: … at least 21 working days
